items.text: Welcome to Python for Data Science I. Python becomes useful for data work when every transformation is explicit. We move from collections to small testable functions and treat error messages as evidence. Your guided lab is to build a reusable profiler for a list of transaction records. The portfolio evidence for this session is a tested Python module and concise debugging log.

Python for Data Science I. දත්ත සමඟ වැඩ කිරීමේදී සෑම පරිවර්තනයක්ම පැහැදිලිව ලිවීම වැදගත්ය. Collections සිට පහසුවෙන් පරීක්ෂා කළ හැකි කුඩා functions දක්වා යමු. Error message එකක් ගැටලුව සොයාගැනීමට ලැබෙන සාක්ෂියක් ලෙස භාවිත කරමු. Guided lab එක: Build a reusable profiler for a list of transaction records. Portfolio deliverable එක: A tested Python module and concise debugging log.

Welcome to Python for Data Science II: NumPy. NumPy gives numerical data a shape and makes whole-array operations concise. We inspect dimensions first, select with masks, and broadcast only when alignment is clear. Your guided lab is to calculate cohort retention and normalized scores from matrix data. The portfolio evidence for this session is a notebook comparing loop and vectorized implementations.

Python for Data Science II: NumPy. NumPy මඟින් සංඛ්‍යාත්මක දත්තවල shape එක පැහැදිලි කර array එකක්ම එකවර සැකසිය හැක. Dimensions පරීක්ෂා කර boolean masks භාවිතයෙන් දත්ත තෝරමු. Alignment එක පැහැදිලි විට පමණක් broadcasting භාවිත කරමු. Guided lab එක: Calculate cohort retention and normalized scores from matrix data. Portfolio deliverable එක: A notebook comparing loop and vectorized implementations.

Welcome to Git and Reproducible Project Structure. Reproducibility means rebuilding a result from code, data, and declared configuration. Git commits preserve decisions, while environments and project boundaries preserve execution. Your guided lab is to refactor the week-one notebook into an installable repository. The portfolio evidence for this session is a repository with tests, a dependency lock, and meaningful commits.

Git and Reproducible Project Structure. Reproducibility කියන්නේ code, data සහ configuration භාවිතයෙන් ප්‍රතිඵලය නැවත සාදාගත හැකි වීමයි. Git commits තීරණ සුරකින අතර environments සහ project boundaries execution එක සුරකියි. Guided lab එක: Refactor the week-one notebook into an installable repository. Portfolio deliverable එක: A repository with tests, a dependency lock, and meaningful commits.

Welcome to APIs and Interactive Data Apps. An API is a contract between systems. We validate status, schema, and timeouts before data reaches analysis, then keep interface state separate from the data layer. Your guided lab is to fetch a public dataset and expose a filtered analytical view. The portfolio evidence for this session is a documented API client and a small interactive app.

APIs and Interactive Data Apps. API එකක් systems අතර contract එකකි. Data analysis එකට පෙර status, schema සහ timeout පරීක්ෂා කරමු. Interface state එක data layer එකෙන් වෙන් කර තබමු. Guided lab එක: Fetch a public dataset and expose a filtered analytical view. Portfolio deliverable එක: A documented API client and a small interactive app.

Welcome to Data Cleaning with Pandas. Cleaning is a documented set of decisions about what fields mean and which observations remain trustworthy. We measure quality before and after every material rule. Your guided lab is to clean a noisy customers and orders dataset with an auditable rule log. The portfolio evidence for this session is a cleaning pipeline, validation report, and rejected-record table.

Data Cleaning with Pandas. Data cleaning කියන්නේ fields වල අර්ථය සහ විශ්වාස කළ හැකි observations පිළිබඳ සටහන් කළ තීරණ මාලාවකි. වැදගත් rule එකකට පෙර සහ පසුව data quality මනිමු. Guided lab එක: Clean a noisy customers and orders dataset with an auditable rule log. Portfolio deliverable එක: A cleaning pipeline, validation report, and rejected-record table.

Welcome to Exploratory Data Analysis. Exploration should reduce uncertainty, not decorate a notebook. We begin with a question, select a comparison, and state what the evidence cannot establish. Your guided lab is to investigate retention differences and produce an evidence notebook. The portfolio evidence for this session is five findings, each paired with evidence and a limitation.

Exploratory Data Analysis. Exploratory analysis එකේ අරමුණ uncertainty අඩු කිරීමයි. ප්‍රශ්නයකින් ආරම්භ කර සුදුසු comparison එකක් තෝරමු. Evidence එකෙන් කියන්න බැරි දේත් පැහැදිලිව සඳහන් කරමු. Guided lab එක: Investigate retention differences and produce an evidence notebook. Portfolio deliverable එක: Five findings, each paired with evidence and a limitation.

Welcome to Feature Engineering by Data Type. A feature is a claim about information available when prediction occurs. We check timestamps and process boundaries so the model cannot learn from the future. Your guided lab is to engineer behavioral features for a churn prediction problem. The portfolio evidence for this session is a feature dictionary with rationale and leakage review.

Feature Engineering by Data Type. Feature එකක් prediction එක කරන අවස්ථාවේ ලබාගත හැකි තොරතුරු පිළිබඳ claim එකකි. Timestamps සහ process boundaries පරීක්ෂා කර model එකට අනාගත data නොලැබෙන බව තහවුරු කරමු. Guided lab එක: Engineer behavioral features for a churn prediction problem. Portfolio deliverable එක: A feature dictionary with rationale and leakage review.

Welcome to Reliable scikit-learn Pipelines. A pipeline makes training and inference execute the same transformations. Fitting stays inside training data, and the serialized artifact is tested with a realistic request. Your guided lab is to build a mixed-type preprocessing and model pipeline. The portfolio evidence for this session is a fitted pipeline, inference test, and feature contract.

Reliable scikit-learn Pipelines. Pipeline එකක් training සහ inference දෙකේම එකම transformations ක්‍රියාත්මක කරයි. Fitting training data තුළ තබා save කළ artifact එක realistic request එකකින් පරීක්ෂා කරමු. Guided lab එක: Build a mixed-type preprocessing and model pipeline. Portfolio deliverable එක: A fitted pipeline, inference test, and feature contract.

Welcome to Linear Regression and Baselines. A useful model must beat a credible simple rule. We start with the median, fit a linear model, and inspect residuals for structure the model missed. Your guided lab is to estimate delivery time and compare against a median baseline. The portfolio evidence for this session is a baseline report with residual diagnostics.

Linear Regression and Baselines. හොඳ model එකක් විශ්වාස කළ හැකි සරල baseline එකකට වඩා හොඳ විය යුතුය. Median එකෙන් ආරම්භ කර linear model එක fit කර model එකට අහිමි වූ patterns residuals මඟින් සොයමු. Guided lab එක: Estimate delivery time and compare against a median baseline. Portfolio deliverable එක: A baseline report with residual diagnostics.

Welcome to Regularized and Nonlinear Regression. Flexible models capture nonlinear structure but can fit noise. We choose complexity with validation evidence and inspect where each model earns its improvement. Your guided lab is to compare ridge, lasso, and gradient boosting on house prices. The portfolio evidence for this session is a model comparison table and justified selection.

Regularized and Nonlinear Regression. Flexible model එකකට nonlinear patterns හඳුනාගත හැකි නමුත් noise එකත් fit කළ හැක. Complexity තෝරන්නේ validation evidence මතය. සෑම model එකක්ම වැඩිදියුණු වන segments පරීක්ෂා කරමු. Guided lab එක: Compare ridge, lasso, and gradient boosting on house prices. Portfolio deliverable එක: A model comparison table and justified selection.

Welcome to Validation, Cross-Validation and Tuning. Validation simulates future use. We define the deployment boundary first, tune only inside training data, and keep one final test untouched. Your guided lab is to design validation schemes for random and temporal datasets. The portfolio evidence for this session is a validation protocol and reproducible tuning run.

Validation, Cross-Validation and Tuning. Validation කියන්නේ අනාගත භාවිතය simulate කිරීමකි. Deployment boundary එක මුලින් තීරණය කර training data තුළ පමණක් tuning කර අවසාන test set එක ස්පර්ශ නොකර තබමු. Guided lab එක: Design validation schemes for random and temporal datasets. Portfolio deliverable එක: A validation protocol and reproducible tuning run.

Welcome to Metrics, Error Analysis and Responsible Evaluation. A metric matters when its errors connect to real consequences. We translate error types into costs, inspect important groups, and include uncertainty in the release decision. Your guided lab is to write an evaluation memo for a high-impact prediction workflow. The portfolio evidence for this session is a decision memo with metrics, slices, and a release recommendation.

Metrics, Error Analysis and Responsible Evaluation. Metric එකක වටිනාකම errors වල සැබෑ ප්‍රතිවිපාක සමඟ ඇති සම්බන්ධතාවයෙනි. Error types operational cost ලෙස බලමු. වැදගත් groups වෙන්ව පරීක්ෂා කර uncertainty සමඟ release recommendation එකක් දෙමු. Guided lab එක: Write an evaluation memo for a high-impact prediction workflow. Portfolio deliverable එක: A decision memo with metrics, slices, and a release recommendation.

Welcome to Logistic Regression, Probability and Thresholds. A classifier produces a score before a class. The threshold belongs to the decision policy, so we choose it with costs, capacity, and calibrated probabilities. Your guided lab is to build a lead-prioritization model under a review-capacity limit. The portfolio evidence for this session is a threshold policy with calibration and cost analysis.

Logistic Regression, Probability and Thresholds. Classifier එකක් class එකකට පෙර score එකක් ලබා දෙයි. Threshold එක decision policy එකට අයත් නිසා costs, capacity සහ calibrated probabilities අනුව එය තෝරමු. Guided lab එක: Build a lead-prioritization model under a review-capacity limit. Portfolio deliverable එක: A threshold policy with calibration and cost analysis.

Welcome to Trees, Ensembles and Imbalanced Data. Accuracy can look excellent when the event is rare. We examine precision and recall, keep resampling inside training folds, and match the operating point to action capacity. Your guided lab is to detect rare payment failures and inspect false alarms. The portfolio evidence for this session is an imbalanced-classification report and operating point.

Trees, Ensembles and Imbalanced Data. අවශ්‍ය event එක දුර්ලභ නම් accuracy ඉතා හොඳ ලෙස පෙනිය හැක. Precision සහ recall පරීක්ෂා කර resampling training folds තුළ තබමු. Operating point එක team capacity එකට ගැලපෙන්න තෝරමු. Guided lab එක: Detect rare payment failures and inspect false alarms. Portfolio deliverable එක: An imbalanced-classification report and operating point.

Welcome to End-to-End Classification Workflow. A production candidate includes preprocessing, configuration, schema, metrics, and limitations. We package those parts as one traceable release. Your guided lab is to turn the week-seven experiment into a repeatable training pipeline. The portfolio evidence for this session is a versioned model artifact, schema, and model card.

End-to-End Classification Workflow. Production candidate එකකට preprocessing, configuration, schema, metrics සහ limitations ඇතුළත්ය. එම සියලු කොටස් trace කළ හැකි එකම release එකක් ලෙස package කරමු. Guided lab එක: Turn the week-seven experiment into a repeatable training pipeline. Portfolio deliverable එක: A versioned model artifact, schema, and model card.

Welcome to Serving, Testing and Monitoring. Serving adds a software contract around the model. We validate requests, return useful errors, test boundaries, and monitor service health, input shifts, and delayed outcomes. Your guided lab is to serve the model with FastAPI and instrument structured logs. The portfolio evidence for this session is a container-ready API with tests and a monitoring specification.

Serving, Testing and Monitoring. Serving මඟින් model එක වටා software contract එකක් එකතු වේ. Requests validate කර පැහැදිලි errors ලබා දී boundaries test කරමු. Service health, input shifts සහ delayed outcomes monitor කරමු. Guided lab එක: Serve the model with FastAPI and instrument structured logs. Portfolio deliverable එක: A container-ready API with tests and a monitoring specification.

Welcome to LLM Foundations and Prompt Design. An LLM generates likely continuations; it does not query truth by default. We make instructions, context, and schemas explicit, then evaluate normal and adversarial cases. Your guided lab is to create a structured data-quality assistant with an evaluation set. The portfolio evidence for this session is a prompt specification, test cases, and failure analysis.

LLM Foundations and Prompt Design. LLM එකක් likely continuation එකක් ජනනය කරන අතර ස්වයංක්‍රීයව සත්‍යය සොයන්නේ නැත. Instructions, context සහ schema පැහැදිලි කර normal හා adversarial cases මත evaluate කරමු. Guided lab එක: Create a structured data-quality assistant with an evaluation set. Portfolio deliverable එක: A prompt specification, test cases, and failure analysis.

Welcome to Embeddings, RAG and Guardrails. RAG supplies evidence at request time. We measure retrieval before final answers, require citations, and abstain when evidence or access is insufficient. Your guided lab is to build a cited assistant over course policies and notes. The portfolio evidence for this session is a RAG prototype with retrieval evaluation and threat model.

Embeddings, RAG and Guardrails. RAG මඟින් request එකේදී evidence ලබා දෙයි. Final answer එකට පෙර retrieval quality මනිමු. Citations අවශ්‍ය කර evidence හෝ access ප්‍රමාණවත් නොවන විට පිළිතුරු නොදෙමු. Guided lab එක: Build a cited assistant over course policies and notes. Portfolio deliverable එක: A RAG prototype with retrieval evaluation and threat model.

Welcome to SQL and Analytical Data Modelling. Reliable SQL begins with grain: what one row represents. We define keys before joining and test whether joins duplicate or discard business events. Your guided lab is to model orders and customers, then compute retention and revenue. The portfolio evidence for this session is a documented SQL model with data tests.

SQL and Analytical Data Modelling. Reliable SQL එකක් grain එකෙන් ආරම්භ වේ, එනම් එක් row එකක අර්ථයයි. Join කිරීමට පෙර keys තීරණය කර events duplicate හෝ අහිමි වන්නේදැයි tests මඟින් තහවුරු කරමු. Guided lab එක: Model orders and customers, then compute retention and revenue. Portfolio deliverable එක: A documented SQL model with data tests.

Welcome to Spark and Distributed ETL. Distributed processing helps beyond one machine, but communication becomes expensive. We inspect partitions and plans, reduce shuffles, and preserve the data contract. Your guided lab is to scale an event aggregation from Pandas to PySpark. The portfolio evidence for this session is a Spark job with execution-plan notes and data checks.

Spark and Distributed ETL. Data එක machine එකකට වැඩි වූ විට distributed processing අවශ්‍ය නමුත් communication මිල අධික වේ. Partitions සහ plans පරීක්ෂා කර shuffles අඩු කර data contract එක සුරකිමු. Guided lab එක: Scale an event aggregation from Pandas to PySpark. Portfolio deliverable එක: A Spark job with execution-plan notes and data checks.

Welcome to Containers, Cloud Architecture and CI. A container standardizes the runtime, not the whole production system. Secrets stay outside the image, checks run before build, and infrastructure boundaries stay explicit. Your guided lab is to containerize the inference service and run its CI workflow. The portfolio evidence for this session is a tested image, architecture diagram, and deployment runbook.

Containers, Cloud Architecture and CI. Container එක runtime එක standardize කරන නමුත් සම්පූර්ණ production system එක නොවේ. Secrets image එකෙන් පිටත තබා build කිරීමට පෙර tests ධාවනය කර infrastructure boundaries පැහැදිලි කරමු. Guided lab එක: Containerize the inference service and run its CI workflow. Portfolio deliverable එක: A tested image, architecture diagram, and deployment runbook.

Welcome to Experiments, Versioning and Monitoring. MLOps is disciplined change management for data and models. Every artifact links to evidence, promotion has an owner, and rollback does not require rebuilding the past. Your guided lab is to create an experiment lineage and staged release checklist. The portfolio evidence for this session is a model release record, rollback plan, and alert specification.

Experiments, Versioning and Monitoring.
